main_text.p: tùm argumentis quàm maximè potuit probabilibus confirmare laboravit. Impostu-rae suae dignas tandem poenas luisse narrat, à Sapore Persarum rege crudeli morte multatum, detractâ pelle, quòd, cùm magna de se praedicaret, filium ipsius, qui in morbum inciderat, sanare non potuit. Manii etiam & opinionis ejus meminit Josephus Albo in Ikkarim l. 2. c. 13. v. Epiphan. & R. Abraham: quem citant etiam Schickardus & Buxtorf in Lex: Talm in מאן[?]היה בקרמונים מי שחשב שהתחילות הראשונות שתים אחת לטוב ואחתלרע[?] וזה היה רעת איש אחר שמו מאני ועל כן נקראו הנמשכים אחריו מאנים i.e. Fuit apud veteres qui putaret quòd principia prima duo essent, unum boni, & alterum mali, &c. & fuit haec sententia viri cujusdam cui nomen Mani, ideoque qui eum secuti sunt appellati sunt Maniani, sive Manichaei.

Quis interim fuerit Βερξιυτ[?] iste à quo secta Magorum denominata, non constat. eorum ritus & deliria ab ipso Nimrode quâ fide petant Ebn Batrik & Georgius Ebnol Amdi, non contendo. Cùm autem Arabum quosdam iis nomen dedisse legamus, illos qui Christum adoratum venerunt, constat & Magos esse potuisse & Arabes.

Eruditio Arabum, &c. Linguae suae peritia, Sermonis proprietas, &c.] At Arabibus Dialecti plures. Diver-sa fuit lingua quâ locuti Hamyar & Arabes puri, ab Mezhar. c.1.ista quâ usi Koraishitae, & in qua conscriptus Alco-ranus. page.notes: Left margin: a short stray dash beside "Quis interim" is not transcribed. The Hebrew margin word after the first note is read as מאן with doubt. The Greek word "Βερξιυτ" is uncertain. The Arabic words are copied as best read, and their vowel marks are not reliable. The final word of the text is cut off at the line end, and the catchword "tu" is read at the lower right. The first note's text "Buxtr" is probably a printing error for "Buxtorf". The Hebrew line "אחת לטוב ואחתלרע" may have a word break missing.
